messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone!

The R group will be meeting this Friday via Zoom (https://fsu.zoom.us/my/ralmond<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fmy%2Fralmond&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7Cd234d0a3eda74c363c7b08dc6f94534a%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638507930035100520%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=9O0syiyL8LrWbJq8L6sM6b7toKClzdT%2BzZbIcLB%2FKgM%3D&reserved=0>) at noon. This week, we will be looking at how R packages are made, and take a look at the source code for a package that Saeyan is looking at for her dissertation project.

Summer is a great time to work on some of your R projects, so please feel free to join us!

If you need access to the R group canvas site, you can join here:

https://canvas.fsu.edu/enroll/AWFYCW<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcanvas.fsu.edu%2Fenroll%2FAWFYCW&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7Cd234d0a3eda74c363c7b08dc6f94534a%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638507930035100520%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=6%2F%2B4wlIqqJ7EnFkS02BfMo%2FYzdD%2BHTEDX60tiuTCydY%3D&reserved=0>

Hope to see many of you this Friday!




Kari Roberts

The R group will be meeting this Friday, in Stone Building room 3203 (or Zoom: https://fsu.zoom.us/j/98450885843<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fj%2F98450885843&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7Cd234d0a3eda74c363c7b08dc6f94534a%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638507930035100520%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=sGFgT9hNSeCyU4OfZeLub8knfor4KW77GFoRC4X2ahQ%3D&reserved=0>) at noon.
